# ADR-031 — Android reminder reboot survival via Expo Notifications' built-in boot rescheduling; no Headless JS scheduler

**Status:** Locked for current Android build

<!-- Decision text below is verbatim from the pre-split docs/DECISIONS.md table row (2026-09-16). Do not edit a Locked decision without explicit owner approval. -->

Android reminder reboot survival uses Expo Notifications' built-in boot rescheduling, verified on the physical Rabbit R1 without opening the app after reboot; no parallel Headless JS scheduler is added
